test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-number cluster in the same way as the second letter-number cluster is related to the first letter-number cluster and fourth letter-number cluster is related to third letter-number cluster. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits).

OP8 : IJ66 :: FN19 : ZH363 :: AW13 : ?
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fe6faec131619e93e07ce362c97de4e8cb6623c4b6981f7ee5455c9053a1e5d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-number luster pair follows the pattern -6, -6 and number follows the pattern - (first number)² + 2 = second number.

1. UQ173 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5729df871b72519d64297db378520d9e4c06ee27e137c1359bb546452c60763.png] 

This letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern -6, -6 and number follows the pattern - (first number)2 + 2 = second number.

2. UR173 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e515234b21e2b9d57398b95f16a52762a25da7963718c07592d0e45e0eaeb48.png] 

This letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern -6, -6 and number follows the pattern - (first number)2 + 2 = second number.

3. UR171 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d1153877d537103930b43b01cdda84b616a61f9462e2a4dcb833cb2c61d3e16.png] 

This letter-number cluster pair follows the pattern -6, -6 and number follows the pattern - (first number)2 + 2 = second number.

4. UQ171

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c8f4c61f097b753bb33541a3e53c0ca5fd86b4f2dba1f7f13421c04d24afece.png] 

This letter-number cluster pair does not follows the pattern -6, -6 and number follows the pattern - (first number)2 + 2 = second number.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**"
